# MD4C

Vendored from https://github.com/mity/md4c at commit
`f9e5eb232b95b737373ae706648cb75bd259ed1a`.

`md4c.c`, `md4c.h`, `entity.c`, `entity.h` and `LICENSE.md` are unmodified

renderer or network dependency is used by Lib-Markdown.
